title: Trick-or-Treaters
description: A troupe of kiddos in quirky costumes blocks the way: "Trick or treat!"

title: A Skeleton Dog
description: A little skeleton pup wants a Halloween treat too, wagging its bony tail!
safe_action: Spend 1 turn rummaging for dog-safe snacks.
risk_action: Spend 1 turn rummaging for dog-safe snacks.

title: The Hologram Ghost
description: Teenagers in bedsheet costumes come charging over with selfie sticks: "Whoa! This roadside hologram ghost looks so real!"
safe_action: Spend 1 turn holding your breath and pretending to be a plastic prop until they leave.
risk_action: Spend 1 turn holding your breath and pretending to be a plastic prop until they leave.

title: A Bat in the Postal Cap
description: Splashed by a warm geyser, a dizzy little lost bat tumbles right into Goolie's postman cap!
safe_action: Spend 1 turn fanning the little bat to cool it down.
risk_action: Spend 1 turn fanning the little bat to cool it down.

title: Halloween Parade
description: A bustling Halloween parade is marching right across the road ahead!

title: Erupting Geyser
description: Whoosh! A roadside geyser suddenly erupts in a tall plume of steam!

title: Sudden Fog
description: A thick blanket of fog rolls in out of nowhere, nudging the little ghost back!

title: Ghost Hunters
description: Two mischievous kids in cheap werewolf masks are waving bright flashlights at the crossroads ahead, playing "Ghost Hunters"!

title: Thawing Hillside
description: The thawing permafrost on the hillside comes tumbling down in a warm mudslide!

title: A Sudden Gust
description: Whoosh! A sudden gust of wind nearly blows the weightless little ghost away!

title: Sulfur Steam
description: A geyser suddenly puffs out a cloud of piping-hot steam, leaving weightless little Goolie too dizzy to open their eyes!
safe_action: Move back 1 node to dodge the hot steam.
risk_action: Move back 1 node to dodge the hot steam.

title: An Unexpected Float
description: A parade of glowing floats suddenly turns onto the street in a whirlwind of confetti and flashing cameras!
safe_action: Move back 1 node to duck away from the human crowd.
risk_action: Move back 1 node to duck away from the human crowd.
